svg.aria-label: Conversational AI avatar studio: Frontend lead of a SaaS studio where teams build, brand and ship talking AI avatars: the dashboard, an embeddable chat widget, Pixel Streaming, white- label theming and the product docs. 3.5k+ commits since 2024. Drone RF detection on Raspberry Pi 5: An SDR sweeps 0–6 GHz, classifies signals and raises alerts over MAVLink, UDP, UART and GPIO. On-device web UI, fleet backend, device agent, signed .deb packages, an APT repository and golden SD images. 1.8k+ commits in 2026. Modular detectors by contract: A Rust platform that runs independently built detector modules: contracts, Rust and Python SDK, signed objects, device runtime, cloud licensing. Camera detector with YOLO models trained on CUDA. Rust · Python · Hailo · DVC. Multi-agent development, on rails: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and Cursor working in parallel on a Mac and a 64-thread Linux box over a tailnet. Own Claude Code mods, hooks and gates: every change passes tests, types and review. two machines, one pipeline.
